en: Black-and-white rural scene showing a dirt road curving past a two- to three-story plastered house with a steep tiled roof, likely an inn or farmhouse. A horse-drawn carriage with a driver stands on the road in front of the house. Under a long awning on the side of the building, several people sit at outdoor tables. Large deciduous trees and dense foliage surround the house, with a wooden rail fence in the foreground and additional small farm buildings in the background. The style suggests an early 20th‑century European countryside setting.
